name: @vox-pop/brand-ui
description: Vox Pop's signature presentation layer — the dot-mark family (AudioDot / ListenDot / ReplyDot / DotString), editorial typography, motion providers and presets, the audio recorder, and the composed EmbedPrompt. Consumed by ALL THREE clients: apps/web (dashboard), apps/public (capture) and apps/embed. Distinct from @vox-pop/ui, which is the generic shadcn/Radix primitive layer. Named brand-ui since 2026-08-22 — it was embed-ui, after the smallest of its three consumers. Framework-portable: no Next.js, no Firebase, no apps/* paths. Auth + uploader + nav adapters arrive via props (ports).

scripts.prepare: if command -v tsc >/dev/null 2>&1; then tsc; fi
